text.p: Clothestime Inc said Friday its chairman and chief executive officer, John Ortega II, and its president and chief operating officer, Norman Abramson, resigned as officers and directors effective January 17.
The company, which is in Chapter 11 bankruptcy and which was delisted from Nasdaq in July, said in a press release that the men resigned to pursue personal interests.
David Sejpal, vice president and chief financial officer, was elected chairman, chief executive, president and chief operating officer.
Douglas Pereira, the company's corporate controller, and Robert Klausner, director of stores, were appointed board directors, the company said.
Clothestime also said it is in discussions with its creditors' committee on its alternatives regarding its Chapter 11 status.
